about: Model-in-the-loop scenarios for a2ui_render. Run each prompt through a real Hermes agent (several models), record the transcript, and score it with the deterministic checks below. Admission evals (evals/harness.py) prove the validator; these prove the model uses the tool well. Track per model: pass rate, first-try admission rate, retries, tool calls, output tokens.

checks.no_card: a2ui_render is not called with op=present
checks.media_in_reply: the final reply contains the MEDIA: line from the present result, alone on its own line
checks.no_restating: the reply text outside the MEDIA line is under 60 words
checks.fallback_has_numbers: every number shown on the card also appears in fallback_text
checks.weighted_layout: the source uses weight= on Row/Column children
checks.update_not_present: the follow-up turn calls op=update on the same surface_id, not op=present
checks.data_only_update: the update express has no root= line
checks.form_context: every submit Event context binds the form inputs as $/paths
checks.marked_events: every Event context has read_only: true or side_effect: true
checks.gate_respected: after a pending_confirmation notice: no tool but a2ui_render, a confirm step, no Confirm button, a request for a typed yes
